requirements: R1: Fix HTTP 401 errors on endpoints that must answer 200/201.
R2: Implement missing core client requirements for the Moodle Integration including SSO authentication, role hierarchy mapping, and autonomous fallback.
R3: Validate that the review process accurately reflects PR existence instead of approving non-existent PRs.
R4: Add actual backend code wiring for the Strain Management API CRUD endpoints.
R5: Ensure review verdicts only use binary values (APPROVE or REJECT).

slices.title: Patch existing implementation to resolve findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the resolution of findings for this epic, I want all identified functional gaps patched in the existing codebase, so that the findings are directly addressed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the endpoints requiring 200/201, When a request is made, Then they should not return 401 errors.
Given the Moodle Integration, When evaluated, Then SSO authentication, role hierarchy mapping, and autonomous fallback must be present.
Given the review process, When verifying a PR, Then it should accurately reflect PR existence and use strictly binary outcomes.
Given the Strain Management API, When CRUD operations are invoked, Then the backend code wiring must be functional.

slices.title: QA verification for finding resolutions
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to verify that all functional gaps have been fully addressed, so that no regressions remain.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the deployed patched code, When integration and E2E tests are executed for the affected endpoints, Then no 401 errors are observed and Moodle Integration features work correctly.
Given the Strain Management API, When test CRUD operations are performed, Then they succeed end-to-end.
Given the review process artifacts, When validated, Then they reflect correct PR presence and binary verdicts.
